name: Prayer Cloths
overview: Scripture illustrates the use of physical objects like handkerchiefs or aprons touched by the Apostle Paul to bring healing and deliverance from disease and evil spirits, as seen in Acts 19:11-12. This practice aligns with the biblical principle of persistent prayer and faith in God's power to heal, exemplified by the woman who sought healing for twelve years (Luke 8:43) and the call to be steadfast in prayer (Romans 12:12). The hope of healing is ultimately grounded in Christ, the Sun of righteousness, who brings restoration and growth to those who fear His name (Malachi 4:2).
